name: SYNAPSE SLAM INVITATIONAL: Neural-Physical Open
description: The SYNAPSE SLAM INVITATIONAL is the premier open-entry hybrid competition in GLMZ, combining physical athletic events with simultaneous neural puzzle and reflex challenges broadcast on a parallel BCI feed. Competitors must maintain peak physical performance while their BCIs execute complex spatial and tactical problems in real time, with the neural score modifying their physical results — a perfect sprint run worth nothing if the neural component collapses. Founded by an independent consortium of BCI researchers and former augmented athletes, the Invitational remains one of the few elite-level competitions not fully owned by a corponation.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 factory worker qualifies for the Invitational using a secondhand BCI and begins winning — attracting corporate interest that feels less like sponsorship and more like acquisition.
The Invitational's neural broadcast is hacked mid-competition, and the intruding signal contains fragmented data that appears to be stolen corporate research.
A competitor discovers that the neural puzzles in this year's Invitational are not random — they map precisely onto the access architecture of a specific corponation's secure network.
